column3: after merging main (#70 composer, #84 settings, #86 automations): ui-input-group draws the token ring on itself when its field is focused and the field draws none; textarea, token-input editor and popup combobox/command search fields draw the token ring inset; settings field, switch, checkbox, usage segments, breadcrumb and nav rows, and the composer chips, context meter and explore links drop their outline-none and primary-soft shadows or outline-primary
column4: the new controls carried 1px primary + 3px primary-soft focus-within shadows or outline-none with no other ring; with Tailwind 4, outline-none plus focus-visible:outline-2 leaves outline-style none, so the composer chips showed no ring at all; fields flush in overflow-hidden cards and popups would clip an outer ring
